salePayment: How was this bill paid? Choose cash, UPI, credit or split in the form.
title: DukaanSet VoiceOS
hint: Speak or type. Review the form, then press its Save button.
privacy: Your browser may process speech through its recognition service. DukaanSet does not store raw audio.
fallback: Microphone unavailable. Type your command below.
duplicate: This draft is ready. Edit details or start a new command.
permission: Your role or this business’s settings do not allow this action.
wrongWorkflow: This command belongs to another workflow. Use global VoiceOS to switch.
customer: Choose the customer in the form.
supplier: Choose the supplier in the form.
priceBasis: Is this price per unit or the total? Choose below.
name: Say or enter a name.
method: Choose cash or UPI in the form.
correction: Choose the item to correct; more than one item is possible.
duplicateContact: A matching contact already exists. Open that account or deliberately create a separate contact.
splitCollection: Enter one collection per method. This command includes cash and UPI.
cashPurchaseOnly: Purchases currently record cash payments. Review the supplier payment manually.
unsupported: Speech recognition is unavailable. You can type instead.
audio: Microphone unavailable. Check your device and retry.
network: Speech service unavailable. Retry or type instead.
silence: No speech detected. Retry or type.
languageError: This recognition language is unavailable. Change language or type.
cancelled: Voice context cleared. Existing manual fields are retained.
unknown: Tell me the action and the details you want to use.
range: Figures use the period shown; outstanding and stock are current.
filled: Draft prepared. Review it before saving.
allowDuplicate: Create a separate contact with matching details
recordedUPI: UPI is manually recorded; bank verification is not connected.
welcome: What would you like to do?
rulesOnly: Commands use tested rules and catalogue aliases. Live generative AI is not required.
insufficientStock: Not enough stock. Reduce the quantity or receive stock first.
priceChange: You are changing the catalogue rate for this bill
resumeDraft: Your draft is ready to continue.
pendingAction: The result is not confirmed yet. Retry this same action; its details are locked to prevent duplicate records.
expiredDraft: Your temporary draft expired. Start a new command.
intentChoice: Create a bill or add these products to stock?
simulationHint: Simulation only. No purchase, sale or catalogue price is changed. Assumes all units sell at the stated rate; excludes taxes, discounts, waste and expenses.
profitHint: Uses current catalogue costs, not historical cost of goods. This is an estimate, not net profit. Incomplete costs are shown as unavailable.
reorderHint: Uses 30 days of recorded sales, minimum stock and open unmet demand. Lead time and coverage are assumptions you can edit. No order is placed automatically.
minimumOnly: No recent sales history. Suggestion uses saved minimum stock and demand.
draftWarning: Existing drafts are unconfirmed. Review them before preparing another order.
reorderSaved: Reorder draft saved. Stock is unchanged until goods are received.
documentFile: Upload text or a text PDF
extractHint: Supports text files and text PDFs up to 2 MB / 10 pages. For scanned images, paste verified OCR text. Nothing is saved or received during extraction.
extractExample:
Supplier: Gupta Traders
10 kg Daal @ 50
Total: 500
extractionReview: Review quantities, supplier, products, costs and totals before recording received goods.
totalMismatch: The stated and calculated totals do not match, or a total is missing.
acknowledgeDocument: I checked every extracted line and total against the original invoice.
noDocumentItems: No supported item rows found. Use “10 kg Daal @ 50” or continue manually.
providerConsent: This sends only this command to OpenAI for a proposed draft. Review every field; nothing is saved.
interpretationReview: The interpreter marked details uncertain. Edit and confirm those fields before saving.
providerUnavailable: Live structured interpretation is not configured. Local commands and manual review remain available.
newCustomerOffer: Prepare a new customer with this bill
noVoice: No supported device voice is available for this language.
reviewInterpretation: I reviewed the interpreted roles, quantities, prices and payments.
heroBenefit: You can do this by voice
heroDescription: Speak or type. Review before anything is saved.
heroDashboard: Ask DukaanSet how your day is going
heroSales: Make your next bill by voice
heroScan: Review a supplier bill with VoiceOS
heroSimulation: Check the numbers before you decide
